news_items.title: AI News Digest #4: The Biggest AI Breakthroughs of Spring 2026
news_items.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5.5 Instant with 52.5% fewer hallucinations, RoboStrategy began trading on Nasdaq under ticker BOT for robotics exposure, and DeepSeek is raising $3-4B at $45-50B valuation with Chinese state backing.
news_items.why_important: Major AI model improvements and significant funding moves in AI/robotics sector indicate rapid commercialization of AI technologies.

news_items.title: World First: Babies Screened for Blindness Using Artificial Intelligence
news_items.summary: AI is being used for the first time to screen premature infants for retinopathy of prematurity in Mongolia, enabling immediate results instead of days-long waits for specialist review.
news_items.why_important: Demonstrates practical AI healthcare applications in underserved regions, potentially preventing childhood blindness at scale.

news_items.title: Rising AI Demand Lifts Cisco to Another Earnings and Revenue Beat
news_items.summary: Cisco shares soared 20% after reporting Q3 earnings beat with $15.84B revenue (+12% YoY), driven by AI infrastructure demand, while planning to cut fewer than 4,000 jobs.
news_items.why_important: Shows strong enterprise demand for AI infrastructure and networking solutions, validating AI investment trends.

news_items.title: 2026 Robotics Update: The Physical AI Ecosystem
news_items.summary: Physical AI is scaling rapidly with new robotics foundation models like NVIDIA's GR00T N2 and Generalist AI's GEN-1 platform, moving beyond factory automation to dynamic real-world environments.
news_items.why_important: Signals maturation of robotics from prototypes to commercial deployment, with new AI models enabling broader applications.

news_items.title: Global AI in Life Sciences Market Gearing Up for Outstanding Expansion
news_items.summary: AI life sciences market expanding at ~20% CAGR through 2034, with major partnerships like Insilico Medicine-Eli Lilly ($2.75B) and NVIDIA-Lilly's $1B AI co-innovation lab for drug discovery.
news_items.why_important: Highlights massive investment in AI-driven drug discovery and the growing economic impact of AI in healthcare.
